Adjusted assessment using the Financial Stability Report (FSR):
- Positives (FSR-consistent): Policy interventions (SMCCF, CPFF, TALF, MLF, expanded swap lines, Treasury and agency MBS purchases) restored market functioning and supported credit availability, keeping overall financial conditions accommodative and reinforcing forward guidance.
- Negatives (FSR-highlighted vulnerabilities): Elevated business leverage and default risk (including in energy), rising delinquencies, pressures on small and medium-sized businesses and households, vulnerabilities in CRE and nonbank mortgage servicers, and episodic funding-market fragilities tied to COVID-19 amplify downside risks to the outlook.
Net: While accommodation and functioning markets temper the tone, the FSR’s emphasis on elevated vulnerabilities and default/delinquency risks warrants a slightly more negative tilt than before.
